name: model-router
description: Routes each prompt to the cheapest model and effort that can handle it, only when the switch beats the prompt-cache miss it causes.

enabled.title: Routing on
enabled.description: Route prompts automatically. /route off and /route auto change it for one session.

classifier.title: Use the classifier
classifier.description: Ask the light model to grade prompts the keyword rules cannot settle (one tiny call, about a tenth of a cent). Off: only obvious prompts are routed.

announce.title: Announce routes
announce.description: Write one dim transcript line per turn saying which model took it and the estimated cost.

lightModel.title: Light model
lightModel.description: Model for trivial prompts (an alias such as haiku, or a full id).

standardModel.title: Standard model
standardModel.description: Model for ordinary, well-specified coding work (an alias such as sonnet, or a full id).

cacheTtlMinutes.title: Prompt cache TTL (minutes)
cacheTtlMinutes.description: How long the API keeps a model's prompt cache warm. 60 on most Claude Code plans, 5 in overage. Lower values make the router switch more eagerly.

minSavingPercent.title: Minimum saving to switch (%)
minSavingPercent.description: Only switch models when the estimated cost of the turn drops by at least this much.
